Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 30

“Others, restricting their food, offer their life-breaths into the life-breaths. All these know sacrifice, and their impurities are consumed by sacrifice.”

The survey closes by gathering every practitioner into one sentence. Whatever the method, Krishna credits them all with knowing what sacrifice is — the intent, not the technique.
